/**
 * A proc declared with its signature: the body starts from the proc's own
 * name, whose output is its parameters.
 *
 * Runs proc Greet: `POST /api/greet` on http server web-api.
 */
export async function greet(args: { readonly name: string; readonly times: number }, opts: CallOptions = {}): Promise<string> {
  const v = await $call("POST", "/api/greet", {
    "name": $encString(args.name),
    "times": $encInt(args.times),
  }, opts);
  return $decString(v, "result");
}

/** Runs proc Main: `GET /api/main` on http server web-api. */
export async function main(_args: Record<string, never> = {}, opts: CallOptions = {}): Promise<string> {
  const v = await $call("GET", "/api/main", {
  }, opts);
  return $decString(v, "result");
}

export function $enc_GreetArgs(x: $t.GreetArgs): unknown {
  return {
    "name": $encString(x.name),
    "times": $encInt(x.times),
  };
}

export function $dec_GreetArgs(v: unknown, at: string): $t.GreetArgs {

  return {
    name: $decString($field(o, "name", at), at + ".name"),

}

// Code generated by vandorf. DO NOT EDIT.
// A React hook per route of each HTTP server, over client.ts: each gives the
// route's last result or error and whether a call is in flight, and cancels
// calls that are no longer wanted.

import * as React from "react";
import * as $c from "./client";

/**
 * A proc declared with its signature: the body starts from the proc's own
 * name, whose output is its parameters.
 *
 * Runs proc Greet through greet (`POST /api/greet` on http server web-api):
 * with args, whenever they change; any time with run.
 */
export function useGreet(args?: { readonly name: string; readonly times: number } | null, opts?: HookOptions): CallState<{ readonly name: string; readonly times: number }, string> {
  return $useCall($c.greet, args, opts);
}

/**
 * Runs proc Main through main (`GET /api/main` on http server web-api): with
 * args, whenever they change; any time with run.
 */
export function useMain(args?: Record<string, never> | null, opts?: HookOptions): CallState<Record<string, never>, string> {
  return $useCall($c.main, args, opts);
}
